pm_exper_user_2727_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some simple and creative weekend projects I could do to refresh the look of my living space without spending too much?
pm_exper_user_2727_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could try giving your coffee table or bookshelves a fresh coat of paint in a fun accent color, or create a painted feature wall with simple patterns. Even painting plant pots or picture frames can bring a pop of personality to the room without spending much.
(b) You could rearrange your furniture to give the room a fresh feel, or add some new decor pieces like throw pillows or a rug. Even displaying items you already own in a new way can bring a pop of personality to the room without spending much.
(c) You could repurpose old glass jars into charming candle holders, or create a DIY terrarium with inexpensive plants and stones. Even making your own fabric cushion covers can bring a pop of personality to the room without spending much.
(d) You could try arranging fresh flowers in colorful vases, or create a cozy reading nook with soft throws and decorative pillows. Even adding a simple gallery wall can bring a pop of personality to the room without spending much.
